name: Quick Money
overview: Scripture warns against the pursuit of quick money, emphasizing that wealth gained hastily or through greed is unstable and ultimately leads to loss or want. Proverbs highlights that diligent labor leads to lasting increase, while hasty or oppressive means result in diminished blessings and trouble. The Bible encourages trusting God's wisdom over striving to become rich by one’s own understanding, urging believers to seek steady, honest work rather than rapid gain.
